title: Enforce soft and hard spend limits on graph runs
narrative: Every graph run must declare how much spend is allowed. Crossing the soft limit winds remaining steps down without treating the job as a hard failure. Crossing the hard limit stops the run immediately. Hard can also be unlimited when no ceiling applies. Related: `fangore_insp_budget_subgraph_rollup` for nested spend, and `fangore_insp_stop_contract` for repeating-step ceilings.[^insp-budget]
implementation: `BudgetPolicy` / `Budget` in `mechaharness.budget`. `GraphExecutor.run` requires `budget_policy`; each node attempt charges the shared ledger. Soft cancel open nodes → status `soft_exhausted`; hard fail open nodes → `hard_budget_exceeded`. `hard_limit=None` means unlimited.
validation: Kind `graph_budget_limits`. Soft expects soft wind-down then hard fail levels. Related fixtures: `tests/fixtures/graph_executor/budget_*.json`, `tests/test_budget.py`.
